content_of_post_to_comment:
I was procrastinating a lot before with doomscrolling. like a literal day could pass that felt just like a few hours and after it I was finding concentrating on reading or even watching 20min videos challenging. now instead of doomscrolling I read posts here and after it I find reading books easier

With ai I had this thing that I was sort of addicted to it. I could even study without it and when interesting thoughts were striking my mind I was instantly writing them to ai literally instead of thinking them out.. now if I have any questions I search similar questions to mine here and I find really valuable answers to them and most importantly: i started counting on my own thoughts when making decisions, not delegating them to AI

so now my procrastination didn’t stop, I just waste my time in reddit. ik procrastination is bad anyways but what I really want to know is if procrastinating here is better than doing it via doomscrolling and ai?

(sorry if I have some mistakes, not native english)
comment: I think there’s a difference between avoiding discomfort and choosing a less harmful distraction. Reddit can still become a rabbit hole, but the fact that you’re coming away with ideas and making decisions with your own brain again is a pretty big shift. I’d watch whether it leaves you feeling clearer or just gives you a different way to avoid starting things.
